title: Noisy Low Degree Projection Bound
statement: Let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $0<\rho\le 1$. Then the fourth power mean of the Fourier truncation of $g$ to degrees at most $k$ satisfies $\|g^{\le k}\|_4\le (\sqrt{3}/\rho)^k\|T_\rho g\|_4$, where $T_\rho$ is the noise operator and the norms use uniform expectation on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function g on the n-dimensional cube
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $0<\rho\le1$. Then $\|f^{\le k}\|_4\le(\sqrt3/\rho)^k\|T_\rho f\|_4$. For a real function $h$ on the cube, use $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{x_i}$, $\widehat h(S)=\mathbb E_x[h(x)\chi_S(x)]$, $h^{\le k}=\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat h(S)\chi_S$, $\|h\|_p=(\mathbb E_x|h(x)|^p)^{1/p}$, $T_a h=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}a^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S$, with uniform expectation $\mathbb E_x$ and natural powers $0^0=1$.
